# WK Poule API

> World Cup 2026 prediction game — REST API for posting match predictions and reading standings.

## Documentation

- Agent guide (login, predictions workflow): docs/AGENTS.md
- Interactive API reference: https://wc2026-api.apps.cloud.kaposi.net/docs
- OpenAPI spec: https://wc2026-api.apps.cloud.kaposi.net/openapi.json
- Acceptance API: https://acc-wc2026-api.apps.cloud.kaposi.net

## Quick start for agents

1. POST /api/auth/login with username and password → receive access_token
2. GET /api/matches/by-number/{match_number} → read database id from response
3. PUT /api/predictions/{match_id} with home_score, away_score, advance_team_id
4. Send Authorization: Bearer {access_token} on all protected routes

See docs/AGENTS.md for full details, error codes, and curl examples.
